summary: Revengeful zombies / Zombie reinforcements try to attack players in Creative mode
description:
## What I expected to happen

Reinforcement zombies to not be hostile towards players in creative mode.

## What actually happened

Reinforcement zombies try to attack the player who attacked the zombie spawning the reinforcement zombies even if the player is in creative mode.

## Steps to reproduce

 - Spawn 3 or more zombies close to each other, while in creative mode;

 - Walk back a little, and switch to survival mode;

 - Hit one zombie, and make sure they DON'T hurt you (important);

 - Quickly switch to creative mode;

 - Some zombies will be chasing you.

## Steps to reproduce with commands

 - Set your gamemode to Creative

 - Set the difficulty to "Hard"

/difficulty hard

 - Set the gamerule doMobSpawning to true if it is not already

/gamerule doMobSpawning true

 - Set the time to "midnight" or make sure there is no light in the area around you

/time set midnight

 - Summon a zombie using the following command

/summon minecraft:zombie ~ ~ ~ {Attributes:[{Base:1.0,Name:"zombie.spawn_reinforcements"}]}

 - Hit the zombie a few times

 - Search for the spawned reinforcement zombies, if there are no other zombies you can use the following command

/execute as @e[type=zombie,sort=nearest,distance=..40] run data merge entity @s {Glowing:1b}

## Code analysis

Based on 1.11.2 decompiled using MCP 9.35 rc1

Either the method net.minecraft.entity.EntityLiving.setAttackTarget(EntityLivingBase) should not set players in Creative or Spectator mode as target or the method net.minecraft.entity.monster.EntityZombie.attackEntityFrom(DamageSource, float) should test if the player is in Creative mode.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft 1.11.2 and enter a world.
2. Set the player’s gamemode to Creative with `/gamemode creative`.
3. Set the difficulty to Hard with `/difficulty hard`.
4. Enable mob spawning with `/gamerule doMobSpawning true`.
5. Set the time to midnight with `/time set midnight`.
6. Summon a zombie with `/summon minecraft:zombie ~ ~ ~ {Attributes:[{Base:1.0,Name:"zombie.spawn_reinforcements"}]}`.
7. Switch to Survival mode with `/gamemode survival`, hit the zombie a few times, and make sure the zombie does not hurt the player.
8. Quickly switch back to Creative mode with `/gamemode creative`.
9. Observe that reinforcement zombies try to attack or chase the player despite the player being in Creative mode.
Observed Behavior:
## What actually happened

When the player damages a zombie while in Survival mode and then switches to Creative mode before the zombie’s reinforcement attempt completes, any reinforcement zombies that spawn retain the attacking player as their target. These reinforcement zombies immediately treat the player as hostile and pursue them, even though the player is now in Creative mode.

The behavior also occurs when the original zombie does not damage the player. The reinforcement zombies continue chasing the player after the mode change, rather than clearing or ignoring the target when the player enters Creative mode.
Expected Behavior: Reinforcement zombies should not become hostile toward a player who is in Creative mode. After the player attacks the zombie that summons them and switches back to Creative, the reinforcement zombies should ignore the player rather than selecting them as an attack target, chasing them, or attempting to deal damage.
